title: ClickNametags
description: Hides all player nametags by default. Right-click a player within range to see their name in the actionbar.
body:
Hides all player nametags by default. Right-click a player within range to see their name in the actionbar.

- All nametags hidden on join via Scoreboard Team
- Right-click a player within `range` blocks → name appears in actionbar
- Actionbar auto-clears when player moves out of range or timer expires

`/nametags reload - to reload your config`
